xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4446: Overdeck Anywhere: set up, join, unlock and sync the Session Vault from the dashboard

plan.title: Overdeck Anywhere: set up, join, unlock and sync the Session Vault from the dashboard
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Setting up, joining or unlocking the Session Vault and forcing a sync all need a terminal (pan vault setup/join/sync). An operator using Overdeck Anywhere from the dashboard alone cannot start the vault, add a second machine, or recover a machine whose key is missing or was retired by a rotation.
narratives.Proposal: Extract the state-changing bodies of pan vault setup and pan vault join into print-free cores (src/lib/vault/setup-core.ts, join-core.ts) that take a value or a prompt callback, so the CLI keeps its exact output and the dashboard calls the same code. Add queued setupVaultFromDashboard / joinVaultFromDashboard / syncVaultNow to the vault service, three operator-only routes (POST /api/vault/setup, /join, /sync), and setup/join/unlock forms plus Sync now in Settings → Session Vault, proven by a Playwright journey on a bare git remote and documented in configuration/session-vault.mdx and docs/SESSION-VAULT.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- A lock action, a pan vault unlock verb, or dashboard-driven key rotation
- Dashboard controls for syncIntervalSec, evict or other vault/config.json keys (link to docs only)
- Setting, changing or removing the passphrase after setup from the dashboard
- Installing the Claude Code Stop hook from the dashboard (--hooks stays CLI-only)
- Changing any pan vault setup/join output line, stream or exit code, or editing their existing tests
- Letting the internal token (pipeline agents, CLI) or a scoped access token call setup, join or sync
- A GET /api/vault/passphrase-suggestion route
- Background sync in a peer dashboard without OVERDECK_VAULT_IN_PEER=1
- Persisting or logging the recovery phrase or a generated passphrase anywhere outside the one HTTP response

autoDecisions.summary: Cores take either a resolved value or a prompt callback invoked where the CLI prompts today
autoDecisions.rationale: setup prompts after printing the phrase and join prompts only after reading the keywrap; plain input->result cores would reorder CLI output and break the exact-stderr CLI tests

autoDecisions.summary: Suggested passphrase is generated server-side ({mode:'generate'}) and returned once with the recovery phrase; no passphrase-suggestion route
autoDecisions.rationale: the issue says setup returns 'any generated passphrase exactly once'; generating server-side means the secret crosses the wire once instead of twice

autoDecisions.summary: Sync now returns 409 sync-not-running on a dashboard whose vault service is not started; the UI shows the button only when status.running is true; Playwright uses OVERDECK_VAULT_IN_PEER=1
autoDecisions.rationale: keeps PAN-4307 NFR-4 (a peer never advances the vault) and follows the PAN-4436/PAN-4437 Playwright precedent

autoDecisions.summary: Auto-sync settings link to the docs page (save-and-sync section) instead of a dashboard control
autoDecisions.rationale: the issue says link to PAN-4436/PAN-4437's auto-sync controls, but neither shipped one; syncIntervalSec lives only in vault/config.json

autoDecisions.summary: Routes accept root-session and device credentials; internal-token and token get 403 after the CSRF/origin check
autoDecisions.rationale: issue scope says operator-only including paired devices; mirrors PAN-4445 D-5 and pairing D-11 placement; route-scopes.ts already defaults devices to admin

autoDecisions.summary: dir: backends are accepted from the dashboard with URL validation (<=2048 chars, no control characters, no leading '-')
autoDecisions.rationale: dir: is a documented backend and callers already hold admin; git clone already uses '--' so option injection is blocked twice

autoDecisions.summary: Join keeps 'other backend' before the flag-conflict check by having the CLI wrapper check config itself
autoDecisions.rationale: preserves the exact current error precedence of joinCommand; the core repeats the cheap check for the dashboard

Move KEY_LOSS_WARNING here. Error messages are the CLI's exact strings (D-3). Import DIR_BACKEND_PREFIX from src/lib/vault/open.ts. Prints nothing, never exits. Write the five WI-1 tests using tests/unit/cli/vault/helpers.ts and a git init --bare remote.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Create joinVault(input) with JoinSecret / KeywrapState / JoinVaultInput / JoinVaultResult / JoinErrorCode exactly as written, following the 7 ordered steps mirroring src/cli/commands/vault/join.ts lines 77-165. Move PHRASE_MISMATCH_MESSAGE and PASSPHRASE_KEY_RETIRED_MESSAGE here (join.ts re-exports them in cli-join-wrapper). A direct phrase is parsed before any backend access; every error after the store opens removes a clone this call created; a wrong passphrase returns before readRef(HEADER_REF_NAME). narrative.Action: PRD WI-5. Add setupVault/joinVault to VaultServiceDeps and resolveDeps. Add setupVaultFromDashboard, joinVaultFromDashboard (both via enqueueVaultOperation, run whether or not the service started) and syncVaultNow (returns {status:'not-running'} when !started, else enqueues runSync(config) and returns {status:'synced', snapshot}). First split cycle(): move everything after maybeRecreateLoop (lines 195-229) into runSync(config); cycle() keeps its guard + maybeRecreateLoop and calls runSync. syncVaultNow must never call cycle() or maybeRecreateLoop, otherwise a call inside the 5 s boot window creates a second sync loop. Never log results (they carry secrets). Tests use the file's existing startVaultService({...}) injection and fake timers.
